results.quote: The MinGMConn problem is NP-hard, even for an input that contains at most one point per row and column.
There exists an efficient O(log s)-approximation algorithm for an s-thin instance (P,D) of MinGMConn.
There is an efficient O(sqrt(log n))-approximation algorithm for MinGMConn.

results.problem: Minimum Generalized Manhattan Connections (MinGMConn) (complete k-partite demands)
results.quote: There is an O(loglog n)-approximation algorithm for MinGMConn when the demands form a complete k-partite graph.

For unit-disk demands, MinGMConn admits an O(1)-approximation. For two-disk demands, we can achieve an O(loglog n)-approximation. For (general) disk demands with maximal radius ratio Δ, there is an O(log Δ)-approximation.
